Microsoft (MSFT) vs Coca Cola (KO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 18.1 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · KO: $47.9B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · KO: +1.9%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · KO: 28.7%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · KO: 27.3%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · KO: 11.0%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · KO: 5.5%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · KO Dec 31, 2025. The periods are not identical.
